title: Especialista em Java (Tech Lead)
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar 100% de forma remota, integrando o time de Tecnologia como referência técnica da squad de backend. Será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time, definir padrões de desenvolvimento, promover boas práticas e garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções construídas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Liderar tecnicamente a squad de backend, servindo como referência para o time.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.
  • Definir padrões de código e arquitetura, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções.
  • Realizar code reviews estruturados.
  • Definir backlog técnico e quebrar épicos em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Conduzir refinamentos técnicos e apoiar na priorização de débitos técnicos em conjunto com o PM.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes (unitário e integração) e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento (GitFlow ou trunk-based).
  • Aportar e disseminar conhecimento técnico na squad, evoluindo a maturidade do time.
  • Atuar como elo de contato entre a squad e outras equipes técnicas do Grupo Casas Bahia (Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e SRE).


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Forte capacidade de mentoria e comunicação clara e didática.
  • Capacidade de delegar tarefas conforme a maturidade do time.
  • Liderança pelo exemplo (hands-on) e capacidade de dar feedback construtivo.
  • Organização, disciplina técnica, paciência e facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Agile, Scrum e Kanban.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Java 11 ou superior, Spring Boot e APIs RESTful (OpenAPI / Swagger).
  • Experiência com JPA/Hibernate, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA).
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, SOLID e DDD (Domain-Driven Design).
  • Experiência com Kafka (produção, consumo, particionamento, DLQ, retry).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AKS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SOLR, MongoDB e Redis.


Informações adicionais:


Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.


Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:


  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.


For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Java Developer Specialist (AWS)
description:
We expect you to be Software engineer with experience building Acceptance and Integration Test Suites in the Enterprise. It helps to have advanced experience working with testing frameworks like cucumber/gherkin, as well as Artillery for load testing.

WORK AS A CONTRACTOR - PST TIME ZONE- 7+ years of professional experience in practice area


A day in the life…

• Contributes to multidimensional projects that involve multiple teams.

• Works with other software engineers on design best practices and conducts code reviews.

• Resolves complex engineering problems, collaborating with others.

• Facilitates cross functional troubleshooting, root cause analysis and engages others when needed.

• Responsible for creating, evaluating, and contributing to feature detailed designs.

• Design, develop, and implement software utilizing an agile project cycle.

• Mentor others on the team and raise the bar for technical knowledge across a wide spectrum.

• Demonstrates thorough knowledge of information technology concepts issues, trends and best practices as they relate to Cloud technologies and system integrations.

• Apply and share knowledge of security coding practices and secure system fundamentals.


Requirement

Needing Someone who would has built an orchestrator in Java or .net, they would have used temporal IO on a project in recent work history. They would have experience with Kafka and Kubernetes, They would possess Devops skillsets where they could build the first pipelines. Has advanced exp working with testing frameworks like cucumber, gherkin, as well as artillery testing.

Software engineer that USED to be a Test engineer would potentially be a good fit for the needs of this role.

Familiarity with Kubernetes.

Familiarity with relational databases - Postgres

Experience with RESTful architecture and micro-services.

Experience with Kafka

Experience with cloud-based services (AWS)

Experience with Terraform

Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery methodologies and tooling.

A deep proficiency of Java (Sprint and Temporal)

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

7+ years of professional experience in practice area

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Legal Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!



⚠️Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Cientista de Dados (IA)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados com atuação na implementação de soluções com IA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
  • Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
  • Conhecimento em SQL/NoSQL;
  • Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
  • Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
  • Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises e


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
  • Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;
  • Utilizar plenamente seus conhecimentos e habilidade para a extração de dados de fontes de diversas origens, ferramentas e formatos, incluindo dados espaço-temporais;
  • Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);
  • Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
  • Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
  • Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.

description:

Sobre a Vaga


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas corporativos, com foco em aprendizado contínuo e evolução técnica.

A pessoa atuará em conjunto com profissionais mais experientes, participando do desenvolvimento de soluções integradas a ERPs, sistemas fiscais e órgãos públicos, com exposição a ambientes de Big Data e aplicações de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento back-end em Java e Ruby , com acompanhamento do time.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento front-end utilizando Angular 7 .
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e consultas em bancos de dados PostgreSQL e Vertica (Big Data) .
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs para integração com sistemas ERP (SAP) .
  • Apoiar em integrações com sistemas fiscais e órgãos públicos (Prefeituras e SEFAZ).
  • Atuar na correção de bugs, melhorias evolutivas e suporte aos sistemas.
  • Seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e documentação.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimentos em Java .
  • Noções de Angular 7 .
  • Conhecimento básico em PostgreSQL .
  • Noções de Ruby .
  • Conhecimento básico em integração via APIs .
  • Interesse em aprender sobre sistemas fiscais , SAP e integrações governamentais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência acadêmica ou profissional com Big Data / Vertica .
  • Conhecimento prévio em sistemas fiscais (NF-e, NFS-e, SEFAZ).
  • Vivência com projetos integrados a ERP SAP .


O que oferecemos:


✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.


We are recruiting hands-on Mechanical / Electrical / HVAC / Facilities generalists with a strong mechanical background to support long-term contractor requirements


Typical Responsibilities

Carry out hands-on work across mechanical / facilities systems, supporting safe, reliable operations.

Interpret engineering drawings to diagnose issues, plan tasks, and verify correct installation/repair.

Support basic troubleshooting across HVAC / electrical interfaces as required for a multi-skilled generalist.

Complete job documentation and communicate clearly in English with site teams and stakeholders.

Follow site safety rules and participate in screening/compliance requirements.


Candidate Profile

Multi-skill background (mechanical-heavy with exposure to electrical/HVAC/facilities).

Previous contractor experience in industrial, energy, manufacturing, or large facilities environments.

Willingness to work in the Balkans region and/or broader Central Asia pipeline locations.


Key Requirements

Mechanical systems experience and ability to read engineering drawings

Strong English (mandatory)

Ability to pass background checks


What We Can Offer

Competitive day rate and standby rate

Accommodation, travel, and food/per diem covered


Compliance / Screening

All candidates must be able to complete a background check.


Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Mechanical Engineer to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.



Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation


Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: \"Consultor Funcional SAP ACM #993332\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de forma exaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

With offices in Latin and North America and Europe, we are present in the industrial routines of the largest companies on the planet! Innovation is in our blood! Our team is leading the way by delivering features companies need to stay competitive. All of this is to improve efficiency and increase productivity for companies by simplifying the SAP asset management process. We deliver data reliability and cost reduction to our partners so that they are increasingly at the top of their game. Be part of our story and lead the digital transformation with us!

We are looking for Customer Success talent with a passion for working in a high growth environment. To help manage our rapid growth, Sigga Technologies is investing in a critical role in Customer Success Management responsible for a unique opportunity to craft our customer success strategies, build strong relationships with a global customer portfolio, and partner with cross-functional Sigga executives. Our ideal candidate is an accomplished problem solver, data driven, and ready to travel worldwide to ensure customer health and drive value to our customers and expansions for Sigga Technologies.

Our ideal candidate is an accomplished problem solver, data driven, and ready to travel worldwide to ensure customer health and drive value to our customers and expansions for Sigga Technologies.

Objectives for the role

  • Drive product adoption post-implementation, enabling expected ROI attainment for the customer.
  • Set, monitor and achieve measurable outcomes and KPIs set with the customer (success criteria) related to customer value realization and mutual success.
  • Become a trusted, strategic advisor for your customers, willing to dig deep and learn about the direction of their company, goals, and how Sigga can help them achieve them.
  • Be the internal voice of the customer and work cross-functionally within Sigga Technologies to escalate risks and present recommendations & solutions.

What you’ll do

  • Trusted Advisor – Build great customer relationships and set customers up for success by:
  • Understanding goals, strategies, & initiatives and establishing Sigga Technologies as the best-in-class workflow
  • Build trusted relationships with users and leaders to help them achieve their personal and organizational goals
  • Recommending best practices based on understanding customer’s business goals, success criteria for getting value
  • Maintain customer health by developing and executing customer success plans that reflect a holistic path for customers to achieve ROI
  • Outcomes and Risk Management:
  • Drive adoption of Sigga Technologies’ products to enable customers to achieve business value and critical outcomes
  • Measure and monitor KPIs to draw insights and execute actions
  • Own customer lifecycle experience including renewal conversations and exceed cross-sell revenue retention goals
  • Partner with Account manager and share growth opportunities
  • Stay current on Sigga Technologies’ products and services and develop use cases to drive customers to adopt best practice standards.
  • Proactively manage at-risk customers and develop success plans, prevent churn and reduce unnecessary escalations.
  • Expand CSPs to include additional outcomes as customer needs evolve
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop customer case studies
  • Build and document new CS processes and procedures including playbooks, process outlines, best practices, engagement strategies, etc.

What we’re looking for

  • Enthusiasm for customer success and excellence, especially within the SaaS space
  • Willingness to learn, collaborative, growth mindset, goal oriented comfortable with ambiguity / changing priorities as part of the start-up culture
  • Proven record of delivering effortless customer experience, and customer-centric internal communications
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to support joint outcomes through customer lifecycles
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively via oral & written formats: PowerPoint and Excel skills are a must, especially with multiple stakeholders/personas
  • Demonstrated creation of data-driven customer action plan strategies

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent time management skills, managing work time responsibly and efficiently
  • Escalation and conflict management skills
  • Ability to be highly collaborative with internal and external teams
  • Independent, critical thinker/problem-resolution skills
  • High accountability to outcomes
  • 5+ years of experience in direct customer engagement roles
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Strong verbal and written English


Preferred Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of account management, customer success, or managed services
  • CRM experience, managing expansion opportunities and customer relationship mapping
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Microsoft Office/O365 experience

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other

  • Located in Brazil; Hybrid in Belo Horizonte office preferred
  • Willing to travel up to 25% (domestic and international)

title: Especialista de Negócios em Geotecnologias
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional sênior e estratégico para atuar na identificação e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócio, com foco em soluções inovadoras para processos críticos dos nossos clientes e na temática ESG. Se você tem paixão por transformar desafios de mercado em propostas de valor baseadas no uso de geotecnologias, inteligência artifical e analytics, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de desenvolvimento de negócios, do insight estratégico à execução das vendas, esta é a sua oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa que usa a tecnologia para transformar negócios e a sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Realizar, no papel de um especialista em tecnologia, apresentações sobre a plataforma Esri e soluções de seus parceiros para clientes e em eventos para o mercado, reforçando a proposta de valor da Imagem.



Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Profundo conhecimento e habilidade comprovada em estruturar propostas de valor, modelos de negócio e ofertas técnicas complexas.

Capacidade analítica e estratégica para identificar tendências, analisar dados de mercado e traduzi-los em planos de ação e oportunidades de negócio tangíveis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de interagir e influenciar executivos e áreas técnicas.

Sólido conhecimento em geotecnologias, especialmente plataforma Esri, e suas aplicações nos diversos mercados.

title: Supervisor de Produção- Estocagem e Expedição
description:
O Grupo Zanchetta é referência nacional na Indústria e processamento de aves e bovinos.


Buscamos profissionais para compor nossa equipe de Expedição para nossa unidade na cidade de Batayporã - MS.


Responsabilidades:

•Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as atividades dos setores de paletização, estocagem, expedição e túnel de congelamento.

•Coordenar as operações de expedição, incluindo o carregamento de produtos e roteirização de entrega e alocação e recursos;

•Manter registros precisos de todos os envios, documentação de transporte e relatórios de desempenho de equipe;

•Garantir que todos os produtos sejam manuseados e embalados de acordo com os padrões de qualidade da empresa;

•Acompanhar a programação de produção da área, repassando as informações à Supervisão;

•Controlar os horários de refeição e pausa de colaboradores, a fim de evitar atrasos e interferência na produção;


Requisitos:

•Formação superior em Engenharia da Produção, Logística ou afins;

•Conhecimento em pacote office;

•Conhecimento e experiência em frigorífico;

•Residir em Batayporã ou Nova Andradina/ MS.
